title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Role  
You'll work directly with the CEO and CFO as their force multiplier — turning executive priorities into organizational execution, keeping the company's most important initiatives moving, and making sure leadership time goes where it matters most. You'll sit at the center of strategy, operations, and finance, with visibility across everything the company does.  
  
What You'll Do

- **Drive strategic initiatives end-to-end** — take ambiguous, high-priority mandates from the CEO and CFO and deliver finished outcomes.
- **Run the executive operating rhythm** — leadership meetings, planning cycles, OKRs/goals, and follow-through on decisions and action items.
- **Synthesize and brief** — distill information from across the company into clear, decision-ready materials for the CEO and CFO.
- **Coordinate across functions** — align engineering, product, GTM, and partnerships; identify and resolve cross-team dependencies before they become problems.
- **Support finance and corporate workstreams** — partner with the CFO on board, investor, and partner materials: analysis, modeling, and narratives that hold up to institutional scrutiny.
- **Act as a trusted proxy** — represent the CEO and CFO in meetings and workstreams, and handle confidential matters with discretion.

What We're Looking For

- **4+ years in management consulting, investment banking, or an equivalent background** (strategy, corporate development, or similar high-rigor roles) — this is a hard requirement.
- **MBA preferred but not required.** Structured problem-solver, equally comfortable with financial models, operational processes, and difficult conversations.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication; you make complex things simple.
- High agency, low ego — you get things done without needing formal authority, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
- Based in or willing to relocate to **Singapore**, with flexibility to travel between the three hubs.

description:
# Enterprise Business Development, AI Infrastructure – APAC

## About 0G

0G is building the infrastructure layer for the next generation of AI applications, combining high-performance compute, storage, and decentralized infrastructure to enable developers and enterprises to build and scale AI systems.

We are looking for an **Enterprise Business Development** to help bring 0G's AI infrastructure solutions to enterprise customers across APAC.

This is not a partnerships or pre-sales role. You will personally own the commercial cycle: identifying target accounts, opening doors, understanding customer needs, building the business case, navigating complex buying processes, negotiating commercial terms, and closing deals.

## What You'll Do

- Own the full enterprise sales cycle across APAC, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close
- Build pipeline from the ground up, with a strong focus on new-logo acquisition
- Sell 0G's compute, storage, and AI infrastructure solutions to enterprises, AI companies, developers, and other high-compute or data-intensive customers
- Engage CTOs, CIOs, Heads of AI, infrastructure leaders, engineering teams, procurement teams, and other senior decision-makers
- Understand customers' AI, compute, storage, and infrastructure requirements and translate them into a compelling commercial proposition
- Develop account strategies for complex enterprise opportunities and drive deals through multi-stakeholder buying processes
- Lead commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, proposals, and contract execution
- Work closely with product and engineering teams when technical support is required, while remaining accountable for moving the commercial process forward
- Build relationships across the APAC AI and enterprise technology ecosystem
- Represent 0G at relevant customer meetings, industry events, and conferences
- Provide direct customer feedback to help shape our product, positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy

## What We're Looking For

- Approximately **5–12 years of B2B technology sales experience**, although we care more about your track record than years of experience
- A proven **quota-carrying enterprise sales** track record
- Demonstrated experience personally sourcing, progressing, negotiating, and closing new enterprise customers
- Strong new-business hunting skills and the ability to generate your own pipeline
- Experience selling technically complex products or infrastructure
- Comfortable selling to both technical stakeholders and senior business decision-makers
- Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills
- Comfortable operating without a mature sales playbook, large support organization, or established brand
- Able to move quickly, operate independently, and adapt as priorities and products evolve
- Based in Singapore, Hong Kong, or other SEA countries, with strong knowledge of APAC enterprise markets
- Fluent English communication skills

## Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

Experience selling any of the following is highly relevant:

- AI infrastructure or GPU cloud
- Cloud compute or infrastructure
- Data infrastructure
- Enterprise storage
- Databases or data platforms
- HPC or accelerated computing
- Developer infrastructure
- Infrastructure SaaS / PaaS
- Data center or cloud connectivity solutions

Experience at an early-stage or high-growth technology company is a strong plus.

title: Enterprise Product Manager
description:
# About the Role

0G is looking for an Enterprise Product Manager to help shape and scale our AI infrastructure products for enterprise customers.

You will sit at the intersection of customers, business development, and engineering—understanding how enterprises want to use AI compute, storage and infrastructure, translating those needs into scalable products, and driving execution from discovery through launch and adoption.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong product judgment with enough technical depth to work closely with infrastructure engineers and enough commercial instinct to understand what enterprise customers will actually adopt and pay for.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have built products in cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, compute, storage, databases, developer platforms, or other technically complex B2B environments.

# Responsibilities

- Own product strategy and roadmap for 0G's enterprise AI infrastructure offerings
- Work directly with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements, workflows, pain points and adoption blockers
- Translate customer and commercial needs into clear product requirements, PRDs and engineering priorities
- Partner closely with engineering on product architecture, scope, trade-offs and delivery
- Distinguish one-off customer requests from capabilities that should become scalable platform products
- Work with BD and GTM teams on enterprise deals, including product feasibility, roadmap alignment and solution positioning
- Define product requirements across areas such as compute, storage, APIs, networking, security, observability, billing and usage management
- Own prioritization across customer demand, engineering constraints and long-term product strategy
- Drive products from discovery and 0→1 development through launch, adoption and iteration
- Define and track product metrics including adoption, utilization, performance, reliability, cost and revenue impact
- Conduct competitive analysis across AI infrastructure, GPU cloud, storage and developer infrastructure
- Develop pricing, packaging and commercialization strategies together with business teams
- Build feedback loops between enterprise customers, BD and engineering
- Represent the product with customers and partners when deep product or technical discussions are required

# Requirements

- **5+ years of product management or closely related experience**, ideally building technical B2B or enterprise products
- Experience working on **cloud infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, compute, storage, databases, networking, developer platforms or similarly technical products**
- Strong track record of working directly with enterprise customers and translating customer needs into scalable product capabilities
- Demonstrated ability to work closely with engineering teams on technically complex products
- Strong product judgment and ability to prioritize competing customer, commercial and engineering requirements
- Comfortable discussing APIs, cloud architecture and distributed systems with technical teams
- Experience owning products from discovery and requirements through launch and iteration
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving startup with ambiguity and changing priorities

title: Product Engineer
description:
## About the Role

We’re looking for a product engineer who takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks. You’ll work across 4–5 products with different technology stacks, identify high-value problems, and carry solutions through design, implementation, testing, documentation, delivery, and operation.

**What You'll Do**

- Understand our apps and the 0G stack well enough to improve the shared platform, not only one feature.
- Solve root causes and make durable decisions using shared systems instead of introducing band-aids or  
  duplicated solutions.
- Own features end-to-end across UI, APIs, server logic, infrastructure, and deployment; do not stop at the layer you are most comfortable in.
- Build and improve AI-agent infrastructure, including LLM streaming, tool orchestration, sandboxed execution, and security boundaries around untrusted code.
- Understand wallet-based identity, signing, embedded and external wallets, and server-side authorization without conflating wallet connection with application access.
- Independently manage dependencies, reviews, blockers, and delivery while raising genuine product decisions and risks early.
- Raise the bar through meaningful tests, sharp PR reviews, and living documentation that stays true to the product.
- Be open to adopting new technologies, AI tools, and better working practices.
- Be reliable enough that when you own an area, the rest of the team can confidently focus on building and expanding other products.
- Treat “done” as delivered, verified, and operating—not merely coded or test-green. Run what you ship with structured logs, traces, metrics, dashboards, alerts, first-line technical support, optimization, and ongoing support for internal teams and external users.

**Technical background:**

- Strong end-to-end TypeScript and React experience across client, server, API design, and serverless or edge runtimes. Remix, Next.js, Vite, and Cloudflare Workers experience is valuable.
- Experience building LLM-powered products beyond basic API calls, including streaming, tool use, prompt pipelines, agent orchestration, or sandboxed execution.
- Comfortable with web3 application development, wallet authentication, signing, embedded and external wallets, and EVM fundamentals.
- Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, production observability, and behavior-driven testing.
- Our stack includes pnpm, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Docker, [<Fly.io>](http://Fly.io), Grafana, OpenTelemetry,Prometheus, Vitest, and Playwright.
